v7 lifecycle identity and field compilation map were not complete enough to prove no-default first-action compilation

separate historical M2 receipt event 65->66 and route-revision-66 readiness snapshot from the live post-activation revision gate
bind exact PF3 project, route, node adjacency, planned/active states and project-rule identity
freeze the ordered lifecycle ready-write -> close Stage 7.3 -> activate Stage 7.4 -> first-active-action protocol/config freeze
complete the unique field compilation map for gate/reasons/fallback, mask/support, residual/risk, tie/missing, coverage, strata/scopes, grid/AURC, verdict, aggregation and outputs

supersession.authoritative_reading: v1-v7 remain immutable evidence. v7 must not be used as a ready gate. Lifecycle and readiness are authoritative only in v8; method semantics remain authoritative in decision-request-v3 plus its explicitly bound high-level-A and upstream sources.

bases.repository_root: 仓库根，即 git 工作树根目录

path_base_declaration.rule: 每个本地文件引用必须给出 path_base、relative_path、sha256；不得跨基准猜测，也不得为尚未创建的文件制造 hash。

project_rule.title: 关闭前的唯一后继激活预检
binding_effect: write a result-blind read-only activation preflight for the unique planned direct successor before requesting or executing current-node closure
the outcome must be exactly activation_preflight_ready or activation_preflight_blocked
a ready preflight does not itself close Stage 7.3, activate Stage 7.4, or authorize the Stage 7.4 experiment

stage_7_4_contract.clause_1: activation preflight in planned state must uniquely bind Stage 7.0, 7.1-R, 7.2 and 7.3 protocols, schemas, ledgers, results and hashes and record existing train/validation/test residual exposure
stage_7_4_contract.clause_6: risk-proxy input, transform, direction, aggregation, tie/missing, coverage grid, integration, minimum support, minimum unique/point resolution, flat tolerance and degeneracy must be frozen before residual reading; the freeze must be the first action after activation

method_pack_M2_v3.future_validity_check: the historical receipt must still read as the 65->66 M2 decision event and must not have been undone, superseded or contradicted; live current route revision is not required to equal 66

stage_7_4_contract_metadata_v1.used_scope: Clause 1/6 metadata, upstream triples and exposure-state metadata only

opaque_handling.hashing_semantics: For the three appended members, shasum read bytes only to emit SHA-256; no content or scientific value was rendered. The two v1-carried result hashes were copied as metadata and subsequently may only be checked by hash-only readback before freeze.

residual_exposure_metadata_from_v1.stage_7_4_claim_limit: No conclusion may rely on test independence; all folds remain non-independent single-ROI descriptive diagnostics.

compilation_closure.proof_boundary: The map below fixes scientific and machine semantics. Formatting may be mechanical only and may not introduce another mask, score, threshold, grid, integration rule, verdict, aggregation, fallback or output category.

authority_and_lifecycle.freeze_phase: active Stage 7.4 first action after activation receipt and before any result read

unit_gate.source: high_level_decision_request_v2 section 结论与共同 unit gate
unit_gate.failed_unit_behavior: no residual, MAE or curve point; retain identity, opportunity count, full-core coverage ledger, reasons and a no-fallback receipt; never remove from unit totals or denominator accounting

scoreable_support_and_abstention.Mconf_predicate: Mconf == 1 iff cos_i is valid and cos_i > 0.1; otherwise Mconf == 0 within its registered domain
scoreable_support_and_abstention.Mconf_semantics: geometry_visibility single factor covering self-shadow permission only; never total confidence
scoreable_support_and_abstention.unsupported_predicate: core AND base_valid_land AND finite cos_i <= 0.1
scoreable_support_and_abstention.unsupported_behavior: permanent abstention at every operating point; remains in base-valid denominator and ledgers; never contributes residual, MAE or accepted count
scoreable_support_and_abstention.uncovered_geometry: cast shadow, horizon/view occlusion and disocclusion/geometric-instability remain not_evaluated

residual_and_risk.units: dimensionless scaled surface-reflectance units, not raw DN
residual_and_risk.risk_source: high-level option A in risk-proxy-decision-request-v2 together with Stage 7.0 MAE definition; M2 does not originate the risk metric
residual_and_risk.risk_formula: accepted_set_MAE = mean(abs(residual_i)) over accepted scored pixels only

tie_missing_and_protocol_error.score_range_population: each curve scope's all finite scored supported per-pixel raw risk_proxy values before point filtering/grid
tie_missing_and_protocol_error.tie_acceptance: atomic whole-group acceptance with no epsilon tie, rounding or secondary sort
tie_missing_and_protocol_error.protocol_error_effect: fail closed with null curve_shape and null scientific verdict

counts.T: core_total_pixel_count for all opportunity pixels in the frozen unit core
counts.A_j: accepted_pixel_count per curve scope and point

coverage.short_alias_policy: selective_coverage is permitted only with alias_of and exact value/null identity
coverage.zero_denominators: T=0 protocol_error; D=0 typed not_scored and insufficient support with undefined D-based ratios null; S=0 insufficient support with acceptance_given_scored null

strata_and_scopes.strata_partition_assertion: mutually exclusive and exhaustive over finite cos_i in [-1,1] per acquisition; failure is protocol_error
strata_and_scopes.conditional_terminal_identity: only a stratum with terminal admissible A=S_h reports max_selective_prediction_coverage_h=S_h/D; otherwise null

M2_operating_grid_and_guards.guard_semantics: governance support guards only, never statistical thresholds or independent sample counts
M2_operating_grid_and_guards.target_q: exact rationals k/20 for integer k in 1..20
piecewise: J=0: every q unreachable with below_min_accepted_support
J>0 and q<c1: unreachable with below_min_accepted_support
J>0 and q>cJ: unreachable with above_max_reachable_coverage
c1<=q<=cJ: j*=max{j:cj<=q}; q=cJ maps to J before canonical deduplication
M2_operating_grid_and_guards.canonical_rule: for q mapping to one j*, the smallest q is the sole reachable canonical record; later q are duplicate_exact_point and retain exact index/coverage/canonical q

M2_tolerances_AURC_and_verdict.AURC_point_sequence: all coverage-ordered admissible exact points with accepted_n>=271; fixed grid does not enter integration
M2_tolerances_AURC_and_verdict.AURC_normalized: area/span only when pack J minimum is met and span>0
M2_tolerances_AURC_and_verdict.AURC_domain: [c_1,c_J] only; report span; no extrapolation from zero, to one or into abstention
M2_tolerances_AURC_and_verdict.delta_predicates: delta>tau_outcome positive; abs(delta)<=tau_outcome zero; delta<-tau_outcome negative
M2_tolerances_AURC_and_verdict.mixed_claim_limit: no consistent direction only; never statistically no signal

aggregation.continuous_first_level: each acquisition x band x fold x curve_scope independently
aggregation.across_acquisition: equal acquisition weight, median and range only
aggregation.categorical_key: band x curve_scope x PF3 risk_proxy_verdict
aggregation.categorical_behavior: count all five verdicts separately and preserve not-evaluable reasons
aggregation.forbidden: pixel pooling as unit replacement, pass/fail collapse, ranking, effective n, p-values, confidence intervals or statistical-significance claims

unit_status_ledger.row_key: acquisition x split x band x fold
unit_status_ledger.required_content: gate state, top/detail reasons, T/D/S by scope, fallback-forbidden receipt and upstream identities

stratum_table.row_key: acquisition x band x fold x one of five strata
stratum_table.required_content: T/D, evidence support, stratum footprint/base-valid/scored counts, canonical coverage, status and supported residual metrics; unsupported rows carry no forced scientific verdict

risk_curve_table.row_key: acquisition x band x fold x one of four curve scopes x point record
risk_curve_table.required_content: scope role/gate, raw score range, exact/admissible/grid identities, canonical coverage, accepted MAE, AURC fields, curve shape, scope-local verdict and reason

aggregation_table.required_content: equal-weight descriptive median/range fields plus five separate PF3 verdict counts and not-evaluable reason counts

reconciliation_manifest.required_content: member/hash, mask, unit terminal state, three named coverage denominators, fold ledger, verdict and every completed output hash; any mismatch is protocol error rather than scientific result

scientific_report.required_content: single-ROI non-independent descriptive boundary, exposure limitation, primary/secondary scope distinction, abstention ledger and explicit not-evaluated claims

lifecycle_sequence.revision_rule: Revision 66 is only the immutable M2 event/snapshot anchor. After ready-write/close/activate, never require current revision 66. The first-action gate is live_current_revision == activation_receipt.afterRevision, whatever that verified value is.

protocol_and_config_must_compile_only_fr: the actual activation receipt for live lifecycle fields
post_activation_first_action.future_hash_policy: compute actual SHA-256 only after completed bytes exist; v8 predicts none

first_action_stop_conditions: ready-write, Stage 7.3 close and Stage 7.4 activation receipts do not form a read-back contiguous revision chain
historical M2 receipt rc_e47f614a7190 no longer reads as the effective 65->66 decision event
project, route, node IDs, adjacency, unique-successor fact, contract receipt or project-rule id/revision drift
Stage 7.4 is not live active immediately before artifact creation
live current route revision does not equal the actual activation receipt.afterRevision
any local binding path/hash in authoritative_local_inputs or the 21-member Clause 1 union mismatches
unresolved_substantive_decisions is not exactly an empty array
either target already exists or both cannot be published as one append-only first-action change set
any Stage 7.3 report/output or residual/alpha/score result value is opened or searched before both targets freeze
any compile-map field requires a default, fallback, new threshold, alternate output category or executor choice
protocol/config disagree, config is invalid JSON, a closed set is violated, or integer/rational checks fail
completed-byte hashes cannot be computed and reconciled
on_stop: Fail closed before result access or experiment execution. Do not create a substitute, partial frozen claim, overwrite, silent v2 target or future hash. Record the incident only in a new append-only artifact.

result_blind_audit.scope_caveat: This window used PF3 intent/state/receipt/rule metadata and opaque path/hash/exposure metadata only; it does not erase earlier exposure by other actors.

artifact_boundary.self_hash_note: v8 does not self-embed SHA-256; report its completed-byte hash externally. Future protocol/config do not exist and have no hash.

verdict.next_action: After v8 completed-byte hash is available, perform the external PF3 sequence ready-write -> close nd_38d128c40d90 -> activate nd_095e71a9eccf with receipt readback at every step; then freeze the two exact artifacts as the first active-state action using live_current_revision == activation_receipt.afterRevision.
verdict.statement: The full Clause 1 union, exposure boundary, M2 v3 decision and complete no-default compile map now close every substantive pre-activation gap. Revision 66 remains a historical decision/snapshot anchor only. v8 is ready evidence, not activation, protocol/config freeze, result access or experiment execution.
